front: Khái niệm 'Reported Speech Tense Backshift' trong Unit 9: Protecting the Environment được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
When the reporting verb is in the past (said, asked), tenses shift back one step: Present Simple -> Past Simple; Present Continuous -> Past Continuous; Will -> Would; Can -> Could.

💡 Ví dụ: 'We are planting trees,' they said. => They said that they were planting trees.
🌱 Bản chất: Transposing past direct utterances into contemporary indirect narrative perspectives.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Changes in time and place words in Reported Speech'?
back:
today -> that day; now -> then; yesterday -> the day before; tomorrow -> the following day; here -> there.

📝 Ví dụ: 'I will clean the beach tomorrow' => She said she would clean the beach the following day.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Temporal and spatial anchoring adjustments.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Change to reported speech: 'Why are wild animals losing their habitats?' the student asked.'?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Reporting question: 'The student asked why...'.
Step 2: Wh-question retains question word 'why', followed by statement word order (Subject + Verb).
Step 3: Backshift tense from are losing to were losing.

👉 Kết luận: The student asked why wild animals were losing their habitats.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Keeping question inversion in reported questions (writing 'He asked me where did I live' instead of 'where I lived').?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Keeping question inversion in reported questions (writing 'He asked me where did I live' instead of 'where I lived').

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: Reported questions become subordinate noun clauses and take standard statement word order (Subject + Verb).
